source_contract: `UpdateFences` (src/clear_cmd.cpp:170-184) loops over the four diagonal directions in order; each iteration reads `GetFence`, offsets to the neighbour with `TileOffsByDiagDir(dir)`, tests the neighbour for a field and may call `SetFence`.
reason: #1014's repair: `update_fence` is one iteration, called once per direction in DIAGDIR order so that each direction's offset and fence bits are constants. With `#[inline]` the compiler keeps it out of line and the clear loop's `generate-tgp-256-1` cost rises by 346.6M instructions (6,415,180 calls); `update_fences` beside it carries the same allowance at base.
retirement_condition: Retires if the compiler inlines the four calls without the attribute, or when the clear tile loop is no longer on the measured hot path.
